title: A long term name shows in full in the toast
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Make sure the shop's own term A (made for this test) has a 31-character name, due 14 days after the invoice date, and is unused.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Deactivate".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The toast reads "term A deactivated" with every character of the name.
  • A long line wraps and nothing is cut off or replaced by "...".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-R12: “Every success toast that shows a term name ({name} or {term}) on the Credit Terms page, in Story 3: Create or edit a credit term and in Story 4: Move Customers shows the full name; a long name wraps and is never cut off.”
